title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-06-05
lineage: Dat (Tascam DA-20) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional 11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a high‑energy June ’69 show highlighted by a thunderous "That's It For The Other One" and an expansive Dark Star suite.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as an excellent upgrade with pristine soundboard clarity that lets listeners hear every nuance. Musically the night erupts with urgency – standout performances of Dark Star, That's It For The Other One, He Had To Die, China Cat > Top of the World and a beautiful Cryptical Reprise make this a must‑hear 1969 gem.

ai_rating.rationale: All detailed reviews are overwhelmingly positive about both performance and sound quality; the few minor inconsistencies (a zero‑star placeholder) do not affect the clear consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note a dramatic improvement over previous copies, describing the audio as crisp, great quality and fully capturing the 1969 live suite.

standout_songs: That's It For The Other One
He Had To Die (ending of Dark Star)
China Cat Sunflower > Top of the World
show_quality.setlist_flow: Extended, flowing sequences with seamless transitions; the show builds to a powerful climax and closes with an expansive jam.
